name: model-stack
description: Routes the model and effort of the main chat turn and of each subagent with TypeSafe's Jev, and shows the roster, decisions and agent graph in a pane.

minUpgradeConfidence.title: Upgrade confidence
minUpgradeConfidence.description: Minimum probability of Jev's choice to move to a dearer tier than the one requested or running.

minDowngradeConfidence.title: Downgrade confidence
minDowngradeConfidence.description: Minimum probability of Jev's choice to move to a cheaper tier; below it the model stays as picked or requested.

riskyThreshold.title: Risky threshold
riskyThreshold.description: Probability of the task being risky (production, money, credentials, migrations, irreversible state) at which it runs on the max tier regardless of confidence.

mainRouting.title: Main chat routing
mainRouting.description: model rewrites the main chat's model and effort; effort keeps your /model and changes only the effort, so the prompt cache is not invalidated.

timeoutMs.title: Jev timeout (ms)
timeoutMs.description: How long to wait for Jev before keeping the model (main) or the default tier (subagents).

defaultTier.title: Default tier
defaultTier.description: Tier used for a subagent when Jev is in doubt or unavailable and Opus asked for no model.

mode.title: Routing mode
mode.description: route applies Jev's choice to the main chat and to eligible subagents; recommend only shows it; off disables it. /stack mode overrides it for the session.

mainFloor.title: Main chat floor
mainFloor.description: Lowest tier Jev may put the main chat on when it is confident; none lets it go down to light. Doubt and fallback still keep the model you picked.
